notes.title: Small Balance Update
notes.content: [p]- decreased weapon purchase prices by 50% for Lure, Glider Drones, Ghost Lights, Particle Cutter[/p][p]- increased max player level from 200 to 999[/p][p]- fixed a typo in Mineral Hound companion unlock dialog[/p][p]- increased health of the Glowing Worm Elite enemy (from 16000 to 20800)[/p]

notes.title: Small update
notes.content: [p]- Updated game icon (in task bar)[/p][p]- Updated game title (in task bar)[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: New Companion: Mineral Hound
notes.content:
- A robot dog companion is available for hire.
- It will follow the player and gather the minerals nearby.
- New TASKS: "Need A Hand", "A Hand For A Friend" - complete them to unlock the Mineral Hound.
- New Dialogs added.
- Woof Woof.
- Beep.
- Bork.

notes.title: Companion Update: Medic Sai
notes.content:
- Medic Sai can be hired now to join the player on a mission. 
- She will automatically follow the player and use her healing equipment.
- New TASK - "Please Heal" - complete it to unlock the hiring options.
- New dialogs for Medic Sai have been added.

notes.title: Balance update 1
notes.content:
Slightly reduced difficulty of the starting waves:
- Enemy Speed reduction: 5%
- Enemy Damage reduction: 10%
- Enemy XP drop increase: 10%
